title: My Fear of Failure Had Me Stuck

top_liked.author: @IheartDogs55
top_liked.text: I found that after my deconversion, I was freed from fear and anxiety. I always thought I wasn't a good enough Christian. I had a terrible temper. Lashing out at others was a deflection from my own inadequacies. If things went wrong, I always thought I had done something wrong.…
